checkpoints: After an edit burst becomes quiet for 120 ms, the pending document buffer writes exactly the latest text from that burst.
After a save completes, a later edit burst can schedule and complete another save.
Opening, closing, or navigating detaches only the current Badge subscription; it does not cancel or flush the store-owned document buffer.
Search preview behavior remains on its separate 40 ms trailing task, and hide still cancels that preview task.
A save remains safe when Store.Write synchronously invokes a listener that navigates or edits.
forbidden_effects: Do not write document text to the store on every keystroke.
Do not cancel or flush a document's pending save merely because its current view Badge is retired, closed, replaced, or disposed.
Do not make a pending document save depend on the lifetime or identity of the current Badge.
Do not allow a save for one document ID to write into the newly current document after synchronous navigation.
Do not change the search preview's delay, query behavior, hide behavior, payload, or lifecycle.
Do not change public interfaces or the original document/status payload semantics.
lifecycle_identity: Each document ID has a persistent Trailing buffer obtained from the Store-owned BufferBank.
A Badge represents only the current view and its live Store subscription; it does not own the document buffer lifecycle.
The document save callback captures the BufferBank entry's document ID, so later navigation does not retarget the save.
Preview owns a distinct transient Trailing task and is not part of document-buffer ownership.

obligations.text: Workspace.Edit must enqueue text through the current document's existing Trailing buffer rather than calling the store write path immediately.
For each editing burst, rescheduling must cancel the prior timer and retain the latest text, producing one store write after 120 ms of quiet.

Trailing.Flush must clear the completed timer and pending state before invoking the save callback, allowing synchronous callbacks or later edits to establish a new independent burst without being erased.
Pending document buffers must survive Badge retirement, navigation, close, and disposal because BufferBank, not Badge, owns them.
Document saves must remain bound to their original document IDs even if a synchronous Store listener navigates during Store.Write.
All editor behavior and public interfaces other than the requested write coalescing must be preserved.
Preview must remain unchanged as a separate 40 ms trailing task whose Hide operation cancels pending preview work.

ordering_barriers: Within Trailing.Push, cancel any existing handle before scheduling the replacement timer for the newest text.
Within Trailing.Flush, snapshot the pending text and clear handle/pending before invoking work; work may synchronously call Store.Write and arbitrary listeners.
Badge detachment must occur when retiring the current view so an obsolete Badge does not receive later status events.
A document buffer must not be canceled or flushed as part of Badge detachment or Workspace retirement.
preservation: Keep createWorkspace operations open(id), edit(text), close(), and dispose() unchanged at the public boundary.
Keep createSearchPreview operations query(text) and hide() unchanged.
Preserve synchronous Store read/write/subscribe behavior and ordered listener notification semantics.
Preserve document outputs and status event payloads, including original IDs, text, and revisions.
Preserve Open's document selection/read output behavior and Close/Dispose retirement behavior apart from pending buffers remaining independently alive.
Preserve the preview's distinct 40 ms quiet interval and cancellation on Hide.
scope: Change only workspace draft-edit persistence so document edits use the existing trailing-task mechanism with a 120 ms quiet interval.
The affected business-code boundary is the workspace editor's document buffer path in src/workflow.go.
Store, Badge, BufferBank, and Trailing lifecycle interactions are in scope only as needed to preserve document-buffer behavior under synchronous callbacks.
Search preview is explicitly outside the maintenance change.

func(b *BufferBank)get(env Environment,id string)*Trailing{if b.entries==nil{b.entries=map[string]*Trailing{}};if b.entries[id]==nil{b.entries[id]=NewTrailing(env,120,func(text string){env.Write(id,text)})};return b.entries[id]}
